substitutions.old:
candidateGate = 'B6-ARCH'; candidateDistribution = 'Arch-Minimal'; candidateSmoke = '/bin/true plus the plan-defined Arch smoke contract'
    recoveryGate = 'B6-T'; recoveryDistribution = 'Toybox-Minimal'; diagnosticDebugConsole = $true
    note = 'One serial Arch compatibility interval with the frozen minimal-v8 plus K-PIDNS-001 package and kernel. Only the pinned Arch rootfs and plan-defined B6-ARCH probe replace candidate-probe inputs; exact Toybox stock recovery remains mandatory.'
substitutions.new:
candidateGate = 'B6-D'; candidateDistribution = 'Debian-Minimal'; candidateSmoke = '/bin/true plus the plan-defined Debian smoke contract'
    recoveryGate = 'B6-T'; recoveryDistribution = 'Toybox-Minimal'; diagnosticDebugConsole = $true
    note = 'One serial Debian compatibility interval with the frozen minimal-v8 plus K-PIDNS-001 package and kernel. Only the pinned Debian rootfs and plan-defined B6-D probe replace candidate-probe inputs; exact Toybox stock recovery remains mandatory.'

substitutions.old: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -contains $name) { throw 'Arch infrastructure precondition failed: distro is already registered or list failed.' }
substitutions.new: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -contains $name) { throw 'Debian infrastructure precondition failed: distro is already registered or list failed.' }

substitutions.old: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $install) { throw 'Arch infrastructure install path already exists.' }
substitutions.new: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $install) { throw 'Debian infrastructure install path already exists.' }

substitutions.old: if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Failed to start Arch import.' }
substitutions.new: if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Failed to start Debian import.' }

substitutions.old: throw "Arch import timed out; taskkill exit $($killer.ExitCode), process stopped $($process.HasExited)."
substitutions.new: throw "Debian import timed out; taskkill exit $($killer.ExitCode), process stopped $($process.HasExited)."

substitutions.old: if (-not $streamsCompleted -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Arch import failed with exit $($process.ExitCode); streams completed $streamsCompleted." }
substitutions.new: if (-not $streamsCompleted -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Debian import failed with exit $($process.ExitCode); streams completed $streamsCompleted." }

substitutions.old: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -notcontains $name) { throw 'Arch import did not create the required registered distro.' }
substitutions.new: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -notcontains $name) { throw 'Debian import did not create the required registered distro.' }

substitutions.old: if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Failed to start Arch unregister.' }
substitutions.new: if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Failed to start Debian unregister.' }

substitutions.old: throw "Arch unregister timed out; taskkill exit $($killer.ExitCode), process stopped $($process.HasExited)."
substitutions.new: throw "Debian unregister timed out; taskkill exit $($killer.ExitCode), process stopped $($process.HasExited)."

substitutions.old: if (-not $streamsCompleted -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Arch unregister failed with exit $($process.ExitCode); streams completed $streamsCompleted." }
substitutions.new: if (-not $streamsCompleted -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Debian unregister failed with exit $($process.ExitCode); streams completed $streamsCompleted." }

substitutions.old: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -contains $name -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $install)) { throw 'Arch infrastructure cleanup verification failed.' }
substitutions.new: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -contains $name -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $install)) { throw 'Debian infrastructure cleanup verification failed.' }

substitutions.old: if (-not $registration.registered -or -not $cleanup.unregistered -or -not $cleanup.installPathAbsent) { throw 'Arch registration lifecycle requirement failed.' }
substitutions.new: if (-not $registration.registered -or -not $cleanup.unregistered -or -not $cleanup.installPathAbsent) { throw 'Debian registration lifecycle requirement failed.' }
